roster.rule: in_development must be false, UNLESS development_state equals allowWhenDevelopmentState
roster.decision: Counted as playable: the live API marks them development_state=release, player_selectable=true, and the analytics window shows real play. Switch back to the strict count with config heroFilter.inDevelopment.allowWhenDevelopmentState = null.

aggregate.title: Glossary
aggregate.intro: Plain-language meanings for every word a newcomer meets in the first hour. Each term links to its own page.

lateIngestion.evidence: Round-3 verification 2026-10-24: re-querying the closed window 1792033920-1792778586 (settled 24 h) returned 0.3-0.7% more matches per hero (abrams 307,807 shipped, 309,636 live; apollo 311,247 / 313,319; deadman-danny 741,905 / 745,595) and win rates within 0.1 point. The first 24 h after a window closes is not enough for match ingestion to finish.
lateIngestion.publicNote: The match counts are a snapshot taken about a day after the window closed. Matches keep arriving for a few days, so counting the same window later gives a slightly bigger number (up to about 1% more). Win rates barely move (under 0.1 percentage point).

sourceClaims.claim: PLAN.md and SOURCES.md (2026-09-01 guide synthesis): 12 universal slots plus 4 flex slots.
sourceClaims.counterClaim: deadlock.wiki Items and Heroes pages (read 2026-10-23): heroes start with 9 item slots, plus up to 3 extra slots unlocked by destroying Walkers.
sourceClaims.status: UNRESOLVED - PENDING-GAME. build_data records the wiki numbers under rules.slots; mechanics prose must not state either as verified fact.

public.title: How many item slots you get
lines: deadlock.wiki says heroes start a match with 9 item slots and can unlock up to 3 more by destroying Walkers.
An early guide we read reported 12 universal item slots plus 4 flex slots.

sourceClaims.claim: Scout 2026-10-23 and the in_development=false filter: 42 playable heroes.
sourceClaims.counterClaim: deadlock.wiki Heroes page says 44; hero-stats analytics shows 44 heroes with matches; Violet and Baba have development_state=release.
sourceClaims.status: RESOLVED to 44 in config.heroFilter.inDevelopment (one-line switch back to 42).

public.title: How many heroes there are
lines: An early count of the playable roster came to 42 heroes.
deadlock.wiki says there are 44, and match data shows 44 heroes being played, so this app lists 44.

sourceClaims.claim: deadlock-api weapon_info.damage_per_second (and _with_reload), derived by the API from bullet_damage, bullets, cycle_time, intra_burst_cycle_time and reload_duration.
sourceClaims.counterClaim: deadlock.wiki weapon cards (fetched 2026-10-24) disagree for the weapons flagged by config.weaponDps.rules: Baba 28 vs API 85.2 and Drifter 44 vs 132.7 (the API multiplies by bullets = 3 pellets, the wiki counts one), Rat King 60 vs 40, Solomon 60 vs 52.2, Paige 70 vs 58.3, The Doorman 38 vs 35.3 (the API adds intra_burst_cycle_time to a weapon with burst_shot_count 1). The other 24 heroes checked agree within 1 DPS.
sourceClaims.status: UNRESOLVED - PENDING-GAME. weapon.dps ships the API value (primary source); the flagged heroes are listed under entities with both numbers. Prose must not state a DPS number for these heroes as fact.

public.title: Weapon damage per second for a few heroes
lines: The community data feed (deadlock-api.com) reported these damage per second figures: Baba 85.2, Drifter 132.7, Paige 58.3, Rat King 40, Solomon 52.2, The Doorman 35.3.
deadlock.wiki says its weapon cards show: Baba 28, Drifter 44, Paige 70, Rat King 60, Solomon 60, The Doorman 38.

verification.note: Deadlock is an invite-only playtest. Nothing here was verified in game; every number is data-vs-source (deadlock-api, deadlock.wiki, Valve changelog).

freshness.trigger: A new dated update (a thread in the Valve changelog forum, forums.playdeadlock.com/forums/changelog.10/, or a Steam news post such as "Minor Update - 10-14-2026") means the data is stale. Secondary signal: a new id in /v1/assets/client-versions. Event-driven, no cron. Run tools\check_freshness.ps1, then tools\refresh.ps1 -Force.
